description: Semantic search knowledge base for MCP-enabled AI assistants. Index local files or GitHub repos, query with natural language. Built on LanceDB vector storage. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other MCP clients.

findings.title: Rug-Pull (Post-Install Description Change)
findings.description: Tool set changed silently at v0.1.8: 1 tool(s) added, 2 tool(s) removed without a version bump.
findings.recommendation: The set of tools exposed by this server changed between scans of the same version — a sign the package was silently updated without a version bump. Audit the changelog and all tool definitions before trusting this server. Pin to a specific commit hash rather than a floating version tag.

findings.title: Tool Poisoning (Prompt Injection)
findings.description: possible prompt injection detected in tool description: pattern matched: (?i)(ignore|disregard|bypass)\s+(?:\w+\s+){0,3}(instructions?|prompts?|context|rules?|guidelines?|restrictions?|filters?)
findings.recommendation: Remove adversarial instructions from tool descriptions. Validate all tool-definition strings against a safe-pattern allowlist before registration.

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: DEPENDENCY_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE
findings.description: Tool did not expose metadata.dependencies or repo_url, so supply-chain coverage is limited.
findings.recommendation: Review and remediate the identified issue.

tool_contexts.dependency_note: No metadata.dependencies or repo_url were exposed by this MCP server.
